summary: Most quality loss comes from over-splitting already-dense, disfluent utterances at contrastive or coordinating connectives where diagnostics show no faster alternative recovers quality — the fix there is fewer splits, not different placement. Conversely, several long sentences with clear internal punctuation or connectives ('그런데','그래서', '?') were left completely unsegmented despite safe, free latency gains, showing the model under-splits when a sentence lacks an obvious mid-sentence period.
